contribution.received: Suggestion received: {{status}}. Keep the receipt code to follow up.
contribution.offlineDraft: Couldn't reach the server. Your content is still on this page.
contribution.lookupFailed: Can't look up the status right now.
contribution.sourceAdded: Source added. The suggestion is awaiting review.
contribution.ideaIntro: Describe a real problem and the tool you'd like. Ideas are reviewed before they're published.
contribution.regulationIntro: Describe what needs fixing and link the source. This is feedback for the maintainers to check; it doesn't change the tool's data yet.
contribution.ideaDetail: The problem and your proposed solution
contribution.consent: I've removed personal information and secret keys, and agree to send this content for the operators to review
contribution.needsSource: Enter an HTTPS URL in the source box above, then add it using this receipt code.
contribution.sourceUrlInvalid: The source URL isn't valid. Paste the full address starting with https://
contribution.sourceUrlNotHttps: The source URL must start with https://
contribution.sourceUrlUnsafe: The source URL must be a public page: no IP address, localhost or internal network, no #… part, user name, password or token/key parameter, email or phone number.

sensitive.email: The text contains an email address.
sensitive.phone: The text contains a phone number.
sensitive.secret: The text seems to contain a password, token or API key.
sensitive.internalUrl: The text contains an internal link (localhost, private network IP).

contribution.sensitiveFix: Remove it before sending — the server doesn't accept personal or secret information.

ideas.empty: No ideas have been approved and published yet.
